steps.title: Aadhaar Verification
steps.description: Enter your Aadhaar details to receive an OTP for verification.

fields.label: Aadhaar Number
fields.patternMessage: Aadhaar number must be exactly 12 digits
fields.helpText: Enter the 12-digit number printed on your Aadhaar card

fields.label: Applicant Name
fields.patternMessage: Name must contain only letters and spaces
fields.helpText: Enter your full name exactly as it appears on your Aadhaar card

fields.label: I hereby consent to the use of my Aadhaar number for the purpose of Udyam Registration and agree to the terms and conditions.
fields.requiredMessage: You must provide consent to proceed

fields.label: Validate & Generate OTP
fields.helpText: Button is enabled only after all above fields are correctly filled

fields.label: Enter OTP
fields.helpText: Enter the One-Time Password sent to your Aadhaar-registered mobile number

steps.title: PAN Verification
steps.description: Provide your organisation type and PAN details for verification.

fields.label: Type of Organisation
fields.helpText: Select the legal structure of your organisation

fields.label: PAN Number
fields.patternMessage: PAN must be in format: 5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter (e.g. ABCDE1234F)

fields.label: Name as per PAN
fields.placeholder: Enter name as on PAN card
fields.patternMessage: Name must contain only letters and spaces
fields.helpText: Required for all organisation types except Proprietorship

fields.label: Date of Birth / Date of Incorporation
fields.helpText: Enter date of birth (for individuals) or date of incorporation (for organisations)
